_comment: Takes this project's own MqttCommunication task off Freewheeling.
The same change as tools/ai/scaffold/mqtt-task-cyclic.json, which fixed the
two site controllers, applied here for the reason this repository
exists: every installation project inherits its task configuration from
whatever the reference looked like when it was set up, so leaving the
reference Freewheeling ships the fault to the next building.
What it cost the last one: Bijbouw stopped dead twice, on 1 and 7 September
2026, with lights, pushbuttons, MQTT and Home Assistant all gone at once and
staying gone until somebody restarted the controller. Both times its
codesyscontrol.log reads:
#### Exception: Processorload watchdog: plcload=99, maxplcload=95
#### Exception: *EXCEPTION* [ProcessorLoadWatchdog] occurred in:
App=[all], Task=[all]
WAGO arms that watchdog in the runtime's own configuration - [CmpSchedule]
ProcessorLoad.Enable=1 / Maximum=95 / Interval=5000 - and it stops every task
in every application with no automatic recovery. A Freewheeling task consumes
every spare cycle by definition, so a controller with one sits permanently
near that ceiling: measured per thread, MqttCommunication took ~32% of the CPU
against MainTask's 1.5%, and a burst tipped one five-second sample over 95%.
Measured after the change, on the same hardware: 5.9% instantaneous and 6.4%
averaged, no longer the largest consumer on the box.
Only Wago_PFC200_G1_Lab has this task. Wago_PFC200_G2_Virtual exists to keep
the DALI block compiled and runs DaliVerify alone.
Run it with:
./tools/ai/codesys.ps1 scaffold -Scaffold tools/ai/scaffold/mqtt-task-cyclic-reference.json -Force
The task already exists, so this updates it. No priority is given: 5 is
correct and stays, below MainTask's 4 so the control logic still preempts
publishing, and above RS485's 15, HvacTask's 8 and Ping's 31. 20 ms is not a
new number either - the task settings already carried Interval=t#20ms, which
CODESYS ignores while the kind is Freewheeling.
docs/_img/SoftwareArchitecture.svg still labels this task 'Prio 1,
Freewheeling'. That diagram is from 2019 and its priorities were already
wrong before this change; its drawio source is deflate-compressed inside the
SVG's content= attribute, so patching the rendered text alone would leave the
two out of step. Redraw it rather than sed it.
